text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s21.e02","problem":"'Key Points' heading box is only 82.5px wide; the real one spans the full text column (372.9px).","fix":"Make the heading a block element at x=19.8, w=372.9, h=25.9, with the same text, bold and left-aligned."},{"element_id":"s21.e10","problem":"Body text is too wide, so bullet and paragraph lines run off the right edge and get clipped ('Disney+', 'Foxtro'). The mock text is about 7% wider than the real one; the font is too big or too widely spaced. Line breaks also differ, and these boxes are 28-30px too wide.","fix":"Set the article font to 16px with letter-spacing 0 and line-height 24px. Set the container to x=19.8, w=372px, padding-right 19px, so text wraps as on the real screen, ending '...ABC and Disney+.' and '...Foxtrot.'. Line 1 of the paragraph should end at 'Yacht'. Apply this to every article text run on s21, s22, s23 and s24, including e11-e20."},{"element_id":"s21.e08","problem":"Inline runs are drawn about 1.2px too high and are wider than the real ones. The italic 'Dancing With the Stars' should be 155px wide but is 165px, so the runs after it are shifted right.","fix":"Shrink the font as above so the italic run is about 155px wide. Shift the text block down 1px, so the top of the 'New episodes' line is at y=294.9. Keep the link runs 'Amber Glenn' (w 89.9) and 'Pasha Pashkov' (w 100.2) starting at x=19.8 and 140.6."},{"element_id":"s21","problem":"The ad image is a flat stand-in illustration (ladder on a grey background), not the real photo of a worker on a roof. The heatmap is red all over the ad.","fix":"Draw the ad image with the same rounded 12px corners at x=56, w=300, h=175. Match the real photo as closely as possible: green foliage top-left, a yellow ladder, a man in a cap in the middle, and a grey shingle roof on the right. Use the real position, 'Test Ad' label at the top and the blue triangle at the top-right. Also use assets/s21.e33.png at x=8, y=20.2, 32x32 for the back button."},{"element_id":"s22.e06","problem":"The bullet text and paragraphs are too wide and wrap differently, so the boxes are off by 2-30px in width and 1px in y.","fix":"Use the same font and container fix as on s21. Text should start at y=166.5 for the bullet ('New episodes'), y=226.3 for the 'Amber Glenn' paragraph and y=310.5 for the 'A rehearsal clip' paragraph. The wrapped italic run should be w=155.1."},{"element_id":"s22","problem":"The ad image is a flat placeholder and does not match the real worker-on-roof photo. The last paragraph 'Glenn found their song choice' also runs over the right edge.","fix":"Draw the ad photo as in s21. Wrap the last paragraph inside the 372px column, so line 1 ends at 'Toto,'. Use assets/s22.e31.png for the back button at (8, 20.2, 32x32)."},{"element_id":"s23","problem":"The text is too wide: 'Disney+' and 'Foxtro' are clipped and the bottom bar text runs into the arrow. The ad image is again a placeholder.","fix":"Apply the same font fix. In the 'Next in More For You' bar, limit the title to a width of about 300px so it wraps 'Scandal' onto the second line and stops before the arrow, which sits at x=363. Draw the real roof photo in the ad."},{"element_id":"s24.e03","problem":"The paragraph text is too wide and shifted up 1.3px, so the boxes are off. The right edge is clipped ('Foxtro', 'mor').","fix":"Move the block to y=16.8 and fix the font as above. Make the italic 'Dancing With the Stars' run w=155.1 at x=159.6, y=40.8 and set the line box for 'featured...' to w=369.9."},{"element_id":"s24","problem":"The ad and the 'DWTS' photo do not match the real screen. The real photo is the face of a blonde woman, while the mock shows a green plant, a head shape and no face. The next-article arrow is off, and the title overlaps it.","fix":"Draw the ad photo as a worker on a roof. Show the woman's face in the photo box at y=628 with a dark background and '#DWTS' at the top-right. Use assets/s24.e22.png at (8, 20.2, 32x32) and assets/s24.e26.png at (363.1, 772.2, 24x24). Limit the next-article title width so it does not touch the arrow."}],"summary":"Layout is close and all taps work, but the article text is set too wide, so the text elements are missed and lines are clipped on the right on s21, s22 and s24. Fix the body font size and container width first; that should bring back around half the missed elements. Then replace the flat ad art with the real photo, and fix the 'Key Points' width and the next-article bar overlap."}
